description: What the gateway hands every demand adapter for one evaluation.

classification.description: What the classifier concluded about the conversation turn. Never contains message text.

commercial_intent.description: 0..1 likelihood the user is in a buying context.

categories.description: Commercial categories detected, most relevant first.

items.description: A commercial content category. Matches fixtures/classify-fixtures.json.
items.title: ContentCategory

sensitive.description: Sensitive topics detected. Any entry blocks ads under strict detection.

items.description: A sensitive topic that blocks ads. Matches fixtures/classify-fixtures.json.
items.title: SensitiveCategory

method.description: llm when the LLM classifier answered in time, rules when only the rule stage ran, cached when a recent classification of the same text was reused.
method.title: ClassificationMethod

prompt_version.description: Version of the classifier prompt or rule set, e.g. sha256:<hex>.

classification.title: Classification

surface.description: Where the sponsored slot would be rendered.

max_creatives.description: Upper bound on creatives to return. v1 returns at most one.

surface.title: Surface

user.description: The user fields a demand adapter may see. Never the tier or user_hash.

region.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code. Optional; when absent the regions rule fails closed and the turn is suppressed with reason region_blocked.

user.title: DemandUser

exclusions.description: Advertiser domains that must not be selected (policy competitor_exclusions). Mediation enforces them; adapters receive them so they can skip work.

items.description: An advertiser domain that must never be shown, e.g. competitor.com.
items.title: AdvertiserDomain

keywords.description: Normalized dictionary terms the rules classifier matched (never raw message text). Adapters use them for keyword overlap.

items.description: A dictionary term matched case-insensitively on whole words. Never message text.

title: DemandRequest
